scope: M2-SLICE-006 workspace diff reconciliation and lifecycle integration

source.binding_note: Evidence was executed against the uncommitted M2-SLICE-001 through M2-SLICE-006 changes on the v0.1.0 baseline; it is not release-candidate or cross-platform evidence.

observation_contract.observation_revision: captured before scan and revalidated after scan
observation_contract.environment_identity: immutable environment_id bound to the workspace project
observation_contract.observation_stability: stable only when workspace identity, locator, head, environment, and revision match before/after scan
observation_contract.scan_timestamp: omitted to preserve deterministic equality; no clock contract exists
observation_contract.state_mutation: none; no CAS, SQLite, lease, revision, operation, or event mutation

notes: Snapshot publication advances head/revision and the next diff is empty.
A restored new destination compares empty against its source snapshot; a subsequent edit is reported.
The scan-time revision test uses a direct SQLite mutation in a test harness to model a concurrent lifecycle writer; it is synthetic coordination evidence, not a host-resource claim.
This is local Windows native development evidence only. It is not M2 release evidence, M1 release evidence, or cross-platform qualification.
M1 release artifacts and artifacts/m1-release-evidence were not modified.
